verdict.rationale: Qodo's docs show automated PR review with severity-ranked findings that explain what is wrong, why it matters and how to fix it. It surfaces issues such as breaking changes, spec gaps and design deviations, and finding types are configurable. That covers the functional-bug half of the story, but nothing in the pack names security findings specifically. missing for 10: explicit documentation of security finding categories (injection risks, leaked secrets, insecure patterns), any evidence that security issues are flagged alongside functional bugs, independent or hands-on corroboration of security detection accuracy.
